title: Lost in Athens, part two
lines: The night is cold and lonely. Me, Cynthia and Pastor Bumrod need a place to stay. And we need to make Ypsilanti by six thirty tomorrow night, to see Great Lakes Christian take on the Eastern Michigan Eagles.
I say we just stay another night in Athens.
Look, I love Athens. It is my old stomping grounds. But we have promised our fans and viewers wall to wall, comprehensive coverage of Mid-American Conference men's basketball.
Doesn't mean we need to see a church league game in Michigan.
Does Abdul even let us go to church league games anymore?
Hey! The good senator is twice the man you will ever be, Pastor.
Please stop, children. I am on low battery. And your nineteen eighty nine Nissan Sentra, Mister Hagan, has an actual cigarette lighter. I need a U S B C to breathe.
As I am about to expire, I recommend we find a wall outlet in Athens.
Hey, my buddy Craig in Miami used to live in one of these apartments on Court Street. Maybe he knows who lives there.
Are you serious? That was thirty years ago.
Well, call him. Maybe he can anchor our A Sun coverage.
